credentials_message: Enter your credentials to connect to {target}
security_encryption_desc: The key generated by the process above is used to encrypt your credentials with the AES algorithm, the same standard used by governments and banks. Without the key, the in-memory data is completely indecipherable.
security_key_derivation_desc: We use an industry-standard algorithm (PBKDF2) that takes your Master Password, combines it with a random 'salt', and runs a hashing process thousands of times. This makes it extremely slow for an attacker to try to guess your password.
security_master_pass_desc: When you create a Master Password, it is NEVER saved to your computer. It exists only in your memory and is used to generate a secure encryption key at the moment of use.
security_master_pass_title: Your Master Password is the Key to Everything
security_session_auto_delete_desc: When you close the application, the temporary vault files are automatically deleted from the disk. On each new launch, you will need to create a new vault for that session.
security_session_temp_files_desc: When you create the vault, two files are temporarily created in the application's folder to store your credentials in an encrypted format during use.
security_session_title: The vault only works for the current session:
security_tips_intro: The security of the vault depends on you:
security_tips_no_sharing_desc: It is the only key to your data during the session. We have no way to recover it for you.
security_tips_no_sharing_title: 3. Do not share your Master Password
security_tips_pc_security_desc: The biggest threat to any password manager is malware on your own computer (like a keylogger). Keep your antivirus and operating system up to date.
security_tips_strong_pass_desc: Use a combination of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols. The longer and more complex, the more secure your vault will be.
vault_confirm_remove_prompt: Are you sure you want to remove the credential for '{alias}'?
vault_create_prompt:
Set your Master Password. It will protect all your saved credentials during this session.

IMPORTANT: This password is not recoverable. If you forget it, you will not be able to access your saved credentials until you restart the application and create a new vault.
vault_create_prompt_session_only:
Would you like to create a temporary vault to save this credential?

This allows you to easily reuse it for other remote actions during this session.

Saved passwords are deleted when the application is closed.
vault_error_new_passwords_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
vault_save_credential_prompt: Do you want to save the credential for '{user}' to the vault for future use?
vault_unlock_prompt: Enter your Master Password to access saved credentials.
